c-notifications-email.1.expected: [site] Alice replied to your topic to bob once with a View in Community button
c-notifications-email.1.actual: One email to bob (once). Subject '[forums] Alice Chen replied to your topic'. Button reads 'View Topic' (type label, 'View in Community' is only the fallback). The intro line quotes the topic title cut at 50 characters mid-word: Alice Chen replied to your topic "What is the recommended way to handle knowledge ba" - no ellipsis (notifier mb_substr(title,0,50)).

c-notifications-email.2.evidence: bob ticked Pause all email notifications on /community/u/bob/edit/ (saved, persisted); alice replied -> no new Mailpit mail to bob, wp_jt_notifications reply_to_post row 22078 created, bell showed 8. Unticked afterwards.

c-notifications-email.3.expected: digest only: no instant email for a reply, digest arrives with unsubscribe link
c-notifications-email.3.actual: bob set to daily via PATCH /users/me/digest-preferences (no member UI exists for it; profile edit page has no digest control). A reply from alice still sent the instant email 'Alice Chen replied to your topic' (22:41:32); picking a digest frequency does not suppress instant mail (Notifier::should_email ignores it). Daily digest did arrive ('forums: Your Daily Community Digest', lists replies to bob's topics, has the unsubscribe link).

c-notifications-email.4.evidence: clicked digest unsubscribe link logged out -> page 'Unsubscribed ... You have been unsubscribed from community digest emails'; meta jetonomy_pro_digest_frequency=none and a re-run of the daily digest sent bob nothing. Note the page says re-enable from profile settings but the profile has no digest control (see proposed check).

c-notifications-email.7.actual: maya @bob in Quick question on help desk -> subject '[forums] You were mentioned by' (name missing, trailing 'by'); same for alice's mention (Mailpit dUAYKuTJxuP7ESteWjxzh8, TpyxNWzzPAxmJmWbM342vt). c-notifications-email.9.expected: staff email keeps Review in Mod Queue button, goes to moderators only
c-notifications-email.9.actual: alice reported Grace's 159-char topic: varundubey, test_moderator and test_admin got an email with button 'Review in Mod Queue' (ok) but subject '[forums] A moderator reviewed your content' and footer 'If you think this was a mistake, reply to a moderator in the community.' - member-facing wording on a staff alert. Intro follows default Settings > Email text. Account deleted afterwards. c-notifications-email.12.evidence: admin replied in Customer Advisory Board (private) mentioning @bob (not a member) -> no Mailpit mail to bob and no jt_notifications row for bob.

c-notifications-email.15.expected: Grace's 159-character title shown whole in subject and body
c-notifications-email.15.actual: Email to grace: intro line cuts the title at 50 characters mid-word ('...photography forum fro'); the full title appears once, lower, in the 'On topic' line. Layout did not break and nothing overflowed.

c-notifications-email.16.evidence: finn (silenced) replied '@bob ...' -> HTTP 403 jetonomy_user_silenced 'Your account is currently silenced and cannot post.'; no email to bob, no reply stored.

c-notifications-email.17.expected: every email type previews and Send test delivers
c-notifications-email.17.actual: All 17 types preview and all 17 Send test calls delivered to Mailpit. But several tests arrive with blank placeholders in the subject: '[forums]  replied to your topic', '[forums]  replied to your reply', '[forums] You were mentioned by', '[forums] New topic in'. The placeholder list under the table omits {actor_display_name}, {space_title}, which the default subjects use.

c-notifications-email.18.needs: a dark-mode mail client; Mailpit cannot render dark mode

proposed_checks: - `c-notifications-email.19` @member #ui #email: after unsubscribing from the digest, the profile settings page offers a way to pick a digest frequency again (the unsubscribe page says to re-enable it there).

- `c-notifications-email.20` @moderator #email: a member flags a topic -> the staff alert subject says a report needs review and does not read 'A moderator reviewed your content' or tell the staff to reply to a moderator.
- `c-notifications-email.21` @member #email +long: a reply to a topic with a title over 50 characters -> the intro sentence names the title with an ellipsis or whole, never cut mid-word.
